refresh_token.label: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: The value of the oauth_refresh_token cookie. Keeps the provider signed in after the short-lived authorization token expires.

user.title: Enter your SoundCloud credentials
user.description: SoundCloud has no public app registration. Sign in to the SoundCloud web player, open your browser's developer tools, and copy the client_id from a network request and your OAuth token from the request headers, then paste them here. Also copy the oauth_refresh_token cookie, so the provider stays signed in. Use a private browser window and close it afterwards, as the provider takes over that sign-in session.

manifest.description: Stream tracks, remixes, and user-uploaded music from the SoundCloud community.
